title: Binyamin bar Ashtor
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim, chapter 1, halakhah 4: “Rabbi Yasi said: Binyamin bar Ashtor presented it before Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba,” etc. Hyman reports Penei Moshe’s explanation that he was descended from converts.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Bikkurim 1:4 paragraph reads Rabbi Yosei and Binyamin bar Ashtor with עשתור, while Hyman supplies Yasi and אשתור. Penei Moshe’s whole corresponding comment explicitly describes bar Ashtor himself as descended from converts. The supplied spelling and translation remain visible; the commentary is not promoted to an authority genealogy.
